notes.title: Version 0.2.266 - Think()
notes.content:
[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Advanced AI Thinking[/b]: [url=https://botforgrindfest.com/api/GrindFest.AutomaticHero.Think.html]AutomaticHero.Think()[/url] and [url=https://botforgrindfest.com/api/GrindFest.AutomaticHero.ClearThoughts.html]ClearThoughts()[/url] methods for sophisticated bot decision-making using remote LLM
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066698/798233014687556f58036e3253cf88afdd240a80.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066698/5ef9e55b54b5af990a0e867a24e62ad74ac3ec09.png[/img]

[*] [b]Visual Basic Scripting[/b]: [url=https://botforgrindfest.com/tutorials/visual-basic.html]Visual Basic.NET support[/url] for bot programming
[*] [b]Enhanced Bot API Methods[/b]:
    - [url=https://botforgrindfest.com/api/GrindFest.Hero.FindNearestEnemies.html]FindNearestEnemies()[/url] for multi-target awareness
    - [url=https://botforgrindfest.com/api/GrindFest.Hero.Attack.html]Attack(enemy)[/url] method for direct combat targeting  
    - [url=https://botforgrindfest.com/api/GrindFest.Hero.AllocateStatPoints.html]AllocateStatPoints()[/url] and [url=https://botforgrindfest.com/api/GrindFest.Hero.AllocateSkillPoints.html]AllocateSkillPoints()[/url] for character progression
    - [url=https://botforgrindfest.com/api/GrindFest.Hero.CarryingCapacity.html]Hero.CarryingCapacity[/url] property for inventory management
[*] [b]Moon Gates[/b]: Socketable runes now act as addresses for portal destinations
[*] [b]Carrying Capacity[/b]: Heroes now have weight limits and cannot carry overly heavy items like ore in inventory
[*] [b]Death Replay[/b]: Partially implemented replay functionality for analyzing combat deaths
[*] [b]Reagent Spawning[/b]: Mandrake roots, mushrooms, and potatoes now spawn naturally in the world
[*] [b]Lumberjacking & Carpentry[/b]: New gathering and crafting skills for wood-based materials
[*] [b]Enhanced Mining[/b]: Tools now have efficiency ratings and improved mechanics
[/list]

[h2]Bot API[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Idle() Method Improvements[/b]:
    - Now automatically walks through different areas as hero level increases
    - healthPotionThreshold parameter to control healing behavior
    - lootPredicate parameter to customize what items to collect
    - Respects 90% carrying capacity limit
    - Defaults to collecting gold, health potions, and better equipment
[*] [b]Party Management[/b]: Gold, gems, souls, and gold cap properties added to [url=https://botforgrindfest.com/api/GrindFest.AutomaticParty.html]AutomaticParty[/url]
[/list]

[h2]Items[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Looking Glass[/b]: Legendary magnifying glass that automatically identifies items when held by selected hero
[/list]

[h2]Quality of Life Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Controller Support[/b]: Enhanced Xbox controller layout with dedicated buttons for pickup, attack, block, item display, and health potions
[*] [b]UI Improvements[/b]:
    - Attack rating now displayed in character window
    - Items can be dropped on experience bar to move to inventory
    - Tooltips display more slowly using alpha transitions
    - Better tooltip positioning
[*] [b]Visual Polish[/b]:
    - Removed lens distortion for more precise mouse aiming
    - Nameplates below ground are now ignored
[/list]

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Heavy items now have special pickup animations and weight considerations
[*] Warriors now start with 3 health potions for better early game survival
[*] Bows shoot significantly faster for improved ranged combat
[*] Monster levels slightly increased in Crimson Meadows and Rotten Burrows
[*] Zombies can no longer swim (they sink as expected)
[*] Summon Skeleton spell now summons fewer skeletons per intelligence point
[*] Last Stand skill: Now has 1-minute cooldown, still heals percentage of health and permanently reduces stats
[*] Attack rating bonuses available in gold shop
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed poison weapons not working
[*] Vases are now properly breakable
[*] Cursed items can no longer be thrown
[*] Player gold properly displayed when trying to pickup over limit
[*] Performance optimization: Removed GC allocations from liquid containers
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.2.238 - Fluid transfer
notes.content:
[h2]New Features[/h2]
[*] Mixing potions and refilling them from vessels and other potions
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066698/5acd113ffdab3a6c12cde0130136083cd9f2ee93.gif[/img]
[*] Discord integration - patrons can link their game account and access special patron role/channels
[*] Potions now glow less when empty
[*] Dropping potion of fire causes it to explode
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066698/c9442ed61d562276d0a206f667848abcaeaabf10.gif[/img]
[*] Container contents now display flattened in tooltips (hold Ctrl to unflatten)
[*] Curse spell added (works like inversed Bless spell - removes stats from non-undead, adds stats to undead)
[*] Unlock spell can now open both chests and doors
[*] New [url=https://botforgrindfest.com/api/GrindFest.AreaBehaviour.Dungeon.html]Area.Dungeon[/url] and [url=https://botforgrindfest.com/api/GrindFest.DungeonBehaviour.Rooms.html]Dungeon.Rooms[/url] API
[*] Default script changed from [url=https://botforgrindfest.com/api/GrindFest.Hero.FollowCursorAndAttack.html]Hero.FollowCursorAndAttack()[/url] to [url=https://botforgrindfest.com/api/GrindFest.Hero.Idle.html]Hero.Idle()[/url]

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]
[*] Wraith enemy added to first area. Wraiths now summons skeletons and casts curse
[*] Adjusted item rarity probabilities
[*] Movement speed, attack speed, and hit recovery speed now scale using logarithmic formula
[*] Default script changed from Hero.FollowCursorAndAttack() to Hero.Idle()

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[*] Fixed opening portals from dungeons
[*] Fixed FindInteractive and [url=https://botforgrindfest.com/api/GrindFest.Hero.FindNearestEnemy.html]FindNearestEnemy[/url] functions
[*] AI now properly uses all available skills
[*] Altar now correctly destroys items with probability based on number of affixes item already has
[*] Mouse raycast in player input adjusted to 1000
[*] Item stats now have more variety
[*] Abyss now gives proper soul rewards for 100+ levels
[*] Item durability now persists through saves
[*] [url=https://botforgrindfest.com/api/GrindFest.Hero.FindNearestEnemy.html]FindNearestEnemy[/url] now ignores enemies in water

notes.title: Version 0.2.225
notes.content:
[h2]Breaking Changes[/h2]
[*] GrindFest.BotApi namespace renamed to GrindFest

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[*] IsPointerOverCustomUI property added to indicate if mouse is over your custom UI and shouldn't interact with the game UI

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[*] Improved documentation of AutomaticHero and tutorials
[*] Added missing footstep sounds for water, snow, sand, and wood
[*] Fixed elf ear model issues
[*] Fixed vases with invalid prefabs
[*] Corrected EquipmentSlotToBodyPartTransformDictionary and Direction namespace, now they are visible in documentation
[*] Enhanced natural biome transitions
[*] Consolidated LootGenerator logic
[*] Hidden temporary skills from skill window
[*] Fixed missing stats, skills, and prices on character creation screen
[*] SafeArea markers now work across all containing areas
[*] Optimized monster spawning distribution across multiple frames

notes.title: Version 0.2.219 - Happy New Year!
notes.content:
[h2]Happy New Year![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066698/b1af42f9327cbb0ae800cd2b9081948d2f01d455.gif[/img]

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]
[*] Depths of Despair made much smaller (still very work in progress area)

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[*] Item skills can now exists after item is destroyed (Fireworks skill on fireworks that explode)
[*] Weapon attack speed now correctly applied to items and displayed in tooltips
[*] RunAroundInArea is now smarter about resetting its state when entering new areas so you don't have to call StopRunningAround
[*] Monster speed scaling adjusted to be less extreme at higher levels
[*] Steam Leaderboard statistics displayed correctly
[*] Force compilation and periodic file watcher are now optional settings
[*] Footsteps can be disabled in settings
[*] Spark spell now works even without the initial mana (this might change in future)

notes.title: Version 0.2.217 - Leaderboards
notes.content:
[h2]New Features[/h2]
[*] Temporary solo Steam Leaderboards with 4 categories: Level, Gold, Kills, and Play Time. Leaderboard opt-out and reset options in settings (if you turn the leaderboard on it will be automatically updated again)
[*] Text Rendering Module, UI Elements Module and UI Module as default references to Bot API

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]
[*] Gold shop items rebalanced - items that directly speed up progression of the game (gold and exp bonuses) now cost more (progression and prices are is still all over the place)

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[*] Gold and level caps now correctly calculated
[*] field ShieldBehavior.Item added
[*] Area floor baker now includes walls, objects on default layer and characters
[*] Campfire does fire damage
[*] Fire damage text is red
[*] Fixed Weather effects orientation and position
[*] All skills now properly target non-enemy objects as well (like barrels, doors, etc.)
[*] Your character is no longer renamed when entering Tainted Tower
[*] River height adjusted to make it easier to escape
[*] Character slope limit increased from 45 to 90
[*] Hero static class now contains properties
[*] Hero static class now contains duplicated xmldoc from AutomaticHero as well as <inheritdoc />

notes.title: Version 0.2.213 - Swimming
notes.content:
[h2]New Features[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066698/f0bc156a96558353bea2453ef8f065d5ebbb3db9.gif[/img]
[*] Stop drowning! Don't get stuck in water though...
[*] Added [url=https://botforgrindfest.com/api/GrindFest.BotApi.Attributes.InvokeOnReload.html]InvokeOnReload[/url] attribute to mark methods that should be called before script recompilation
[*] Added frame rate limiting settings
[*] Steam branch displayed in settings under version, beta branch contains most recent development

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[*] Exit button in menu doesn't instantly quit the game if you are not in the character selection
[*] Magic find and gold bonus on status screen work, plus added experience bonus
[*] Prestige items giving incorrect bonus values (was 1/10th of intended)
[*] Script compilation error messages now properly showing in console when you try to run bot
[*] Script compiler now properly detects if you want to use single file with top level statements or multiple files with classes

notes.title: Version 0.2.210
notes.content:
[h2]New Features[/h2]
[*] Added [url=https://botforgrindfest.com/api/GrindFest.BotApi.Hero.Party.html]Party property[/url] to Hero in Script API
[*] Fixed handling of top-level statements and class-based bot files to work together

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]
[*] Starting hero class stats loweered from 30/20/10 to 10/10/10
[*] Low quality items are weaker, zombies are still very weak enemies

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[*] Immortal creatures (like training dummies) now have gold health bars and show damage numbers
[*] Fixed getting stuck at draw bridge and in Depths of Despair and monsters not spawning, it's very work in progess area, it's still very empty.
[*] Fixed camera zoom smoothing for smoother gameplay
[*] Fixed damage colors for poison and light damage types
[*] Fixed [url=https://botforgrindfest.com/api/GrindFest.BotApi.Hero.FindNearestItem.html]FindNearestItem()[/url] to work without parameters
[*] Fixed percentage display in item tooltips, especially for shields

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066698/c097e65380949bfe11b77c8c659027eb59ab5f18.gif[/img]
